title: Parse: Extract requirements from OSCORE
description: Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description
close_reason: Already fixed: Python OSCORE oracle (crypto/oscore.py) already implements RFC 8613 requirements and passes 29 tests against official test vectors. Requirements extraction was done implicitly during implementation - see SECURITY comments and test coverage for key derivation, sequence number limits (2^40-1), replay window, ID length validation, and SSN restore.
